title: Tuning Large Multimodal Models for Videos using Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback
caption: Figure 2: Illustration of the proposed VLM-RLAIF. An LLM tuned with video-text instruction-following data, i.e., multimodal SFT model, often produces responses that are not temporally and visually grounded to the video input, as depicted in red color. We propose a method that involves using the VLMM to supervise itself by providing self-preference feedback of generated responses using reward model, refining itself and facilitating the alignment of video and text modalities.
